0022600117.text: The Detroit Pistons (2-0, 1st in the Central, 2nd in the East) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (3-0, 1st in the Atlantic, 3rd in the East) for a regular season game, Detroit's third of the season. Detroit is without Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain), and Ausar Thompson is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision, while Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), LeBron James (out, back), and Tacko Fall (out, quadriceps strain), with Jabari Walker day-to-day with a knee issue and also a game-time decision. The Pistons won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 116-93 win in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026, and the teams have not played each other yet this season.
